reasoning: The changes coincide with some useful schema-grouping repairs: News API filters and CNN’s newspaper selector moved to optional parameters correctly. But most sampled failures persisted, and one task regressed through extra, mismatched calls and incorrect parameter placement. The added selector and endpoint-identifier guidance is too easy to overapply; it did not reliably resolve exact endpoint names, canonical enum values, or tool-specific required/optional groups.
meta_skill_content: Make future edits surgical: compare the exact calls and parameter deltas, then patch only a repeated, evidenced failure. Keep schema-group validation, but require checking each endpoint’s own schema—do not generalize required/optional placement across tools. Prioritize wrong endpoint, unsupported extra calls, and noncanonical values over adding more broad rules: recurring examples include extra arithmetic/group lookups, endpoint-name substitutions, and guessing enum values such as Bybit’s category. Preserve exact listed tool identifiers; use provider/API composition only when the tool metadata explicitly requires it. Treat new selector or regional-mapping guidance cautiously: add a field only when the request and documented mapping support it, never an empty placeholder. Avoid duplicating existing coverage rules; verify each proposed edit against both the failure it targets and regressions it could invite.
